result.title: PRIMFLOW: Learning Trajectory Primitives for Few-Step Distillation
result.summary: Few-step trajectory distillation aims to learn accurate global updates from dense local supervision along a teacher's sampling trajectory. Existing approaches construct within-step dynamics using specific trajectory parameterizations or discrete interval predictions, tying the learned update to a prescribed temporal structure. We propose \method, which directly learns a continuous trajectory primitive representing cumulative displacement along the teacher trajectory. By supervising finite differences of the primitive with local teacher velocities, \method learns the accumulated motion directly, while obtaining global updates through endpoint differences. This formulation avoids prescribing a temporal basis or fixed query grid and instead learns the temporal evolution of cumulative displacement from local supervision. We further establish a local-to-global error bound to characterize how local regression errors affect full-interval displacement accuracy, and introduce endpoint absorption to eliminate the auxiliary primitive branch while preserving one-network-evaluation inference. Experiments on large-scale text-to-image generation show that \method achieves a T-FID of 20.92 and an HPSv2 score of 28.35 at one NFE, improving both metrics over a trajectory-distillation baseline. After endpoint absorption, it retains comparable performance, achieving a T-FID of 20.86 and an HPSv2 score of 28.33.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PRIMFLOW，直接学习教师采样轨迹上表示累积位移的连续轨迹原语：用局部教师速度监督其有限差分，再由端点差得到全局更新，并给出局部到全局误差界，配合端点吸收在保持单次网络评估推理的前提下去除辅助分支；在文生图少步蒸馏上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「局部监督聚合成全局更新」及局部到全局误差界，可能为 latent 推理轨迹训练中步级监督如何累积、误差随步数放大提供可核查线索；但对象是扩散采样轨迹而非推理状态，迁移需较多核查。
